entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A knight-trained planeswalker who uses electrical magic and shares a Spark with her brother Will.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Rowan's brother, who shares a Spark with her.

events.summary: Rowan and her brother Will are the only known planeswalkers to share a Spark, so wherever one goes the other must follow.
events.quote: the only Planeswalkers known to share a Spark.

relations.note: Brother and sister who share a Spark.
relations.quote: Rowan Kenrith and her brother Will are unique in the Multiverse
